rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality expanded/early expanded blastocyst with compact A-grade ICM, looser B-grade TE, and thinning zona, which is broadly consistent with the provided 3AB grading; minor overinterpretation from a static image (e.g., collapse/re-expansion, vacuolated cells).
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, PCOS, ovarian reserve, prior biochemical pregnancy, endometrial thickness, BMI, semen parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to morphology and age; slight overreach in percentile ranking/top-tier comparisons and some speculative image-based details.

Generally aligns with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF counseling, including emphasis on morphology not equaling euploidy and reasonable follow-up; minor deviations include speculative comments on letrozole/metformin and somewhat broad PGT-A framing.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management, luteal support, follow-up timing, lifestyle adjustments, and structured future-cycle planning with contingencies.
